scope: development comparisons; varying objectives and observed area; not reliability qualification

landmarks.scope: evaluator-only target catalogue; ideal occluded semantic detections

missions.error: independent contact qualification failed; aborting trial

physical_witness.scope: evaluator-only foot poses, 0.2 s dwell; not exploration completeness

uncertainty_calibration.scope: reference-policy episode bound under exchangeability; control feedback/domain shift require fresh validation

pose_graph.method: root-anchored SE3 graph, robust sparse least squares

localization.uncertainty_scope: conditional filter plus path/innovation drift allowance; not a calibrated probability guarantee

localization_evaluation.envelope_scope: initial-translation-aligned position error at every active control tick, including degraded periods; evaluator only

gp.kernel: Matern32-ARD x RBF(observed localized plane-side features)
gp.information_contract: estimated onboard range surfaces and count windows; no material/source metadata

missions.information_contract: planner receives body-frame noisy LiDAR transformed by IMU/leg/LiDAR estimated pose and counting-detector observations only

count_calibration.scope: pre-assimilation count diagnostics; upper latent-rate envelope plus Poisson 99% quantile, not a calibrated joint predictive distribution
